capabilities: Create and view custom fantasy calendars with weeks, months, eras, moons, and leap rules
Manage events with recurrence, notes, and images in a calendar and event explorer
Render standalone and Markdown-embedded timelines with tag, year, and era filters
Generate and edit weather from configurable weather packs
Track in-world time with a per-calendar fantasy clock and Frontmatter event import
disambiguation: Not a real-world clock, date, or timezone tool; it manages fictional campaign calendars and in-world time.
extras: The plugin is unreviewed by Obsidian staff, stores all data as JSON files in the vault, and offers a community download library of calendars and weather packs. The README lists current limitations including manual (non-continuous) Frontmatter import and active development.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to model fictional calendars, campaign events, or in-world timelines for tabletop roleplaying settings.

relations.evidence: For integration with TTRPG Tools - Controls, the plugin exposes
The importer also supports Calendarium-style wildcard patterns through YAML objects

summary: TTRPG campaign toolkit providing custom fantasy calendars, event management, timelines, moon phases, weather generation, and in-world time tracking.
